# Welcome

This is an exercise book for [SPH5009](https://canvas.nus.edu.sg/courses/96080) at the NUS Saw Swee Hock School of Public Health.
Each numbered section corresponds to a week of the course. Contents are being dynamically built and adjusted as our course progresses to reflect the learnings in class.

## Setup before first day of class

Follow these [instructions](https://cerm-nus.github.io/r-intro/chapters/setup.html#r-first-then-rstudio) in **Section 1.1** to install *R* and *Rstudio*.
Once installed, check out **Section 1.2** to familiarize yourself with the Rstudio interface.
